label: PF Backlog 190
title: Backend: backfill missing journal for backlog item BI-0131 (pre-existing gap)
body:
## Problem / why
Dashboard item `BI-0131` has NO `history/BI-0131.jsonl` (pre-existing gap from a historical direct
write that bypassed core/backlog.py). The schema expects every item to have a journal.

## Goal & value
Backfill a single, clearly-marked first journal line so every item has a journal. Do NOT fabricate a
real transition - mark it as a backfill.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- `backlog.history('project','ProductForge-Dashboard','BI-0131')` returns 1 entry whose
  `event == "backfill"`, `at` = the item's `created_at`, note = "journal created retroactively".

## Data model
- Writes `history/BI-0131.jsonl` only (owner core/backlog.py). No item change.

## Verification / test plan
- item count == journal count for the dashboard scope; gate green.

dashboard_impact.reason: Internal/data-quality fix; no dashboard/UI behaviour change.

_note: core/backlog.py:backfill_journal(scope,project,eid) added (idempotent, never fabricates). Wrote 1 backfill line for products/ProductForge-Dashboard/backlog/history/BI-0131.jsonl. Dashboard item/journal counts now match.
